text: stain it: Or, challenge it | let the blackness of the day terrify it: Or, let them terrify it, as those who have a bitter day
let it not be joined unto the days: Or, let it not rejoice among the days
the dawning of the day: Heb. the eyelids of the morning
weary be at rest: Heb. wearied in strength
before I eat: Heb. before my meat
the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me: Heb. I feared a fear, and it came upon me
